summary: Produced design artefact src/design/definition.md covering PD-01 (Create definition) and PD-02 (Graph validation). The artefact specifies the two-file module layout (store.zig for DB-backed CRUD, graph.zig for pure structural validation), all shared data types (NodeType, DefinitionStatus, GraphNode, GraphEdge, DefinitionGraph, Definition), full public function signatures with parameter and return types, eight named PD-02 validation checks (CHK-01 through CHK-08) with violation codes and a DFS algorithm outline for cycle detection, database column mapping to migrations/004_definitions.sql, concurrency safety analysis for the HTTP 409 path, error taxonomy with HTTP status codes, state transition diagram, dependency constraints, and a full PD-01/PD-02 acceptance criteria traceability table. No implementation code was written. All three acceptance criteria are met.

issues_found.description: Naming discrepancy between backend_developer_guide.md §2 (which names the definition files 'registry.zig' and 'validator.zig') and the handoff task description (which specifies 'store.zig' and 'graph.zig'). Design artefact follows the handoff task. BACKEND-DEV should confirm final file names before implementing.

next_steps: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) to implement src/definition/store.zig and src/definition/graph.zig per the design artefact.
